flags.why: “Đầu cơ cơ hội” is not a natural Vietnamese expression for exploiting opportunities for personal gain.
flags.fix: Anh ta đầu cơ chính trị để kiếm lợi cho mình. = He exploits political opportunities for his own gain.

flags.why: “Các sư thầy” refers to Buddhist monks here, not nuns.
flags.fix: She pressed her palms together and bowed to the monks.

flags.why: “Ươm” does not mean a silkworm producing silk; “ươm tơ” refers to extracting silk from cocoons.
